name: Kingly Shakedown
label: Quest
description: Kingly Shakedown: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.
Well nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!
Me advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' Ironforge and get to Stormwind. Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!
